subject.why: Clear folded patchwork quilt featuring the requested nine-patch layout and central wagon wheel applique.

category.why: Follows category 2 with a clean two-tone yellow split studio background viewed slightly from above.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: Centered subject with solid silhouette and ample margins around all edges.

colour.why: Vibrant and warm palette with good separation between the subject and the yellow backdrop.

detail.why: Keeps shapes broad and chunky without noisy textures or excessive micro-detailing.

style.why: Smooth volumes, soft highlights, and satin finish consistent with reference art.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (88% of the background); planned yellow
